# createFunctionFromSource

<!-- @constructive-io/graphql-codegen - DO NOT EDIT -->

Creates a `Function` from its `CREATE FUNCTION` source text.

## Usage

```bash
csdk create-function-from-source --input.apiExposed <Boolean> --input.clientMutationId <String> --input.databaseId <UUID> --input.schemaId <UUID> --input.source <String>
```

## Examples

### Run createFunctionFromSource

```bash
csdk create-function-from-source --input.apiExposed <Boolean> --input.clientMutationId <String> --input.databaseId <UUID> --input.schemaId <UUID> --input.source <String>
```
